title: Fallacy of the Single Cause
coreMove: Break the false inference inside single cause, then decide from current evidence instead of the tempting story.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Fallacy of the Single Cause as a specific decision error around single cause, multi-causality, Tolstoy. Traceable support includes Nexus Causality, Moral Warfare, and Misattribution Arbitrage.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Fallacy of the Single Cause as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: break the false inference inside single cause, then decide from current evidence instead of the tempting story.

hook: Do not open with a definition of Fallacy of the Single Cause.
Do not use a generic panic-at-a-meeting opener.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable shape where the obvious answer is wrong and the opposite is true.
Do not make Fallacy of the Single Cause sound like ordinary carelessness.
examples: No coffee mug, classroom whiteboard, bus depot, radiator, bike helmet, or narrow kitchen shell.
No example may skip the specific mechanics of Fallacy of the Single Cause.
